note: Things in the twin/profile that are NOT yet confirmed (PV names, motor roles, links). Each item says what value is in use, why it is doubtful and how to confirm it. Edit status/note in the GUI (Beamline Twin > To verify; right-click > Edit) once confirmed; 'ref' says where the value lives. Never confirmed by guessing: status 'verified' needs evidence in 'note'.

items.subject: retiga2 (hutch B tomo camera) PV prefix
items.why: Taken from the CS-Studio IOC Control list (row 'Tomo_in_B', Windows QImage IOC on aszu). Nothing on the displays says that 'retiga2' is that camera, and the displays have no PV panel for it, so the image PV (<prefix>Pva1:Image per camera_pva_suffix) may not exist under this name.
items.how: At the beamline: confirm with staff which camera is in B; check that QIMAGE2:Pva1:Image (or the IOC's real image PV) exists and shows the B tomo view; then set the real suffix/prefix. Also the B-TOMO element (tomoB) is not linked to this camera yet.

items.subject: E fast shutter: which motor is x and which is y
items.why: Log-panel motor descriptions (FS2X E = m77, FS2Y E = m75) and mpe_bluesky agree; the CS-Studio layout button labels them FS_X = m75, FS_Y = m77.
items.how: Staff / jog test at the shutter (not from BLADE): which motor moves it horizontally.

items.subject: LabMotion SMS (C): x and z motors
items.why: Log-panel descriptions (samXC = m25, samZC = m27) and mpe_bluesky say x = m25, z = m27; the CS-Studio LabMotion_SMS button labels m25 samZ and m27 samX. y = m26 is the same on display and logs (mpe_bluesky had 1idGalil1:m1).
items.how: Jog m25 and check the direction relative to the beam (+Z is the beam direction on the panel).

items.subject: 1idc:m31 role (LabMotion translation or rotX?)
items.why: Display: LabMotion_TransX / Trans_X. Log panels: 'rotXC'. mpe_bluesky has rotx = 1idGalil1:m2 (not on display or logs).
items.how: Read the motor record description (DESC) of 1idc:m31 on the beamline.

items.subject: Hydra D4 z motor
items.why: Display button opens P=1idc: M=m7 (Hydra_D4); mpe_bluesky has 1ide1:m7; the logs never show it. A C-hutch IOC prefix driving an E detector is plausible but unusual.
items.how: Check which of 1idc:m7 / 1ide1:m7 exists and moves Hydra D4.

items.subject: B Kohzu slit blade motors
items.value: Xp m60, Xn m59, Yp m61, Yn m58 (4slitGraphic)
items.why: The B layout's test_slits panel lists m32 instead of m59; 1idb:m32 is Table1 M0X on the top panel, so m59 is more likely.
items.how: Read the slit record 1idb:SlitHxn / the motor descriptions.

items.subject: SAXS D6 shield motor
items.why: Only from mpe_bluesky; the SAXS_D6 panel on the display has m51, m52, m53, m54, m66 but not m49.

items.subject: E-station shutter PV (S01ID-PSS:SES:)
items.why: A/B/C = FES/SBS/SCS are paired with the labelled control buttons; SES is the fourth status PV, assigned to E by elimination (the display has no E control).
items.how: Compare the E-Station status box with the SES PV.

items.subject: NF D2 TiltY motor prefix
items.why: The logs give the name 'NF TiltY' only by motor number 6; the NF_D2 panel has both 1ide1:m6 and 1ide:m6.

items.subject: gh1 pixel size
items.why: The user wrote '69 micron' once; 0.69 was adopted and fits the real frames, never confirmed against a calibration target.
items.how: Image a ruled target / known slit through gh1.

items.subject: B hutch lens stacks: mapping stack -> BL4/BL5
items.why: Both display buttons are labelled Stack1 (motors m43/m45 and m25/m64); which lens each belongs to is a guess.

items.subject: hutch C Tomo camera IOC: 1idSP5 or 1idPG5
items.why: The Tomo D1 (C) button opens an ADSpinnaker panel for 1idSP5 and a pointGrey panel for 1idPG5; the IOC list has only 1idSP5.
items.how: Check which IOC is running on the beamline.

items.subject: HEM motor roles 1idHEM:m1, m4, m5-m8
items.why: The HEM energy-change display shows six motors without axis names.
items.how: Read the DESC of each motor.

items.subject: Header strip PVs of the C/E panels
items.why: PV names truncated on the screenshots.
items.how: Open the header widget properties in CS-Studio.

items.subject: 31 log-panel devices with no PV attached
items.why: A PV is attached only if printed on a window title on >= 3 images; the rest stay open by policy (no guessed links).
items.how: Match each to a display motor (cs_registry.json) when evidence appears.
